_comment: Floors asserted by CI (eval/harness.py --check-thresholds). Regenerate the
numbers with `make eval`; raise a floor only when an improvement is real and
`gated` is the shipping configuration: the CLI's default --min-confidence 0.6.
`corpus` reports everything including the review queue, so its precision is
deliberately much lower - that tier is a queue, not an assertion.
`probe` is the only non-circular corpus recall figure.
